# @web-ts-toolkit/moo

Mongoose helpers for schema fields, ObjectId checks, and document plugins.

## Main Patterns

Partial-index schema fields:

```ts
import { Schema } from 'mongoose';
import { uniqueEmptiableString, uniqueNullableString } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo';

const userSchema = new Schema({
  email: uniqueNullableString('email'),
  username: uniqueEmptiableString('username'),
});
```

Strict ObjectId guard:

```ts
import { isObjectId } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo';

if (isObjectId(req.params.id)) { doSomething(); }
```

Cascade-delete plugin:

```ts
import { cascadeDeletePlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/cascade-delete';

userSchema.plugin(cascadeDeletePlugin, {
  model: 'Session',
  localField: '_id',
  foreignField: 'userId',
});
```

Model-function plugin:

```ts
import { modelFunctionPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/model-function';

userSchema.plugin(modelFunctionPlugin, {
  fnName: 'fullName',
  fn: (doc) => `${doc.name}`,
});

// static + instance methods `fullName` and `fullNameById` are now available on the model
```

New-document plugin:

```ts
import { newDocumentPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/new-document';

userSchema.plugin(newDocumentPlugin, {
  fn: async (doc) => {
    await sendWelcomeEmail(doc.get('email'));
  },
});
```

Keycloak user-sync plugin:

```ts
import { keycloakUserSyncPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync';

userSchema.plugin(keycloakUserSyncPlugin, {
  client: authenticatedKeycloakFluentClient,
  realm: 'application',
  identifyBy: ['providerId', 'username', 'email'],
  managedRoles: ['admin', 'editor', 'viewer'],
  managedAttributes: ['tenantId', 'plan'],
  paths: { password: 'pendingPassword' }, // pragma: allowlist secret
  syncFields: { email: true, firstName: true, lastName: true, roles: true, attributes: true, password: true },
  passwordTemporary: true,
  mapPassword: (doc) => doc.get('pendingPassword') as string | undefined,
  attributePaths: ['tenantId', 'subscription.plan'],
  mapAttributes: (doc) => ({
    tenantId: doc.get('tenantId'),
    plan: doc.get('subscription.plan'),
  }),
  onError: reportSyncError,
});
```

## Gotchas

- peer dependency: `mongoose >= 8`
- optional peer dependency: `@egose/keycloak-fluent ^0.7` only for `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync`
- root entrypoint exports schema helpers, `isObjectId`, and non-Keycloak plugins; dedicated plugin subpaths are also available
- Keycloak user sync is not re-exported from root or `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins`; import it from the direct subpath
- `isObjectId(...)` is a strict guard: it rejects strings that `ObjectId.isValid` accepts but that don't round-trip back to the same string
- `uniqueNullableString`/`uniqueEmptiableString` return partial-index field definitions, not full schemas
- new-document plugin runs its callback only after the first successful `save()` of a newly inserted document
- Keycloak sync covers document `save()` and document `deleteOne()`, not query updates/deletes
- Keycloak sync errors are logged and rethrown by default; MongoDB saves have already committed when post-save sync runs
- duplicate-email realms prioritize providerId/username; email lookup is rejected when more than one exact match exists
- Keycloak attributes sync from the `attributes` path or `mapAttributes`; values become string arrays
- use `managedAttributes` for keys the plugin may remove; unmanaged remote attributes are preserved
- use `attributePaths` when `mapAttributes` reads dynamic paths outside the default `attributes` path
- password sync is opt-in with `syncFields.password: true`; map a plaintext pending password, not a stored hash
- password updates use Keycloak reset-password; `passwordTemporary` defaults to false

## Subpaths

- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/is` — `isObjectId`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/schema` — `uniqueNullableString`, `uniqueEmptiableString`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/utils` — `isSchema`, `isObjectIdType`, `isReference`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins` — re-exports all plugins
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/cascade-delete` — `cascadeDeletePlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/model-function` — `modelFunctionPlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/new-document` — `newDocumentPlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync` — `keycloakUserSyncPlugin`
